summary: Copies two dword fields of the receiver to caller-provided output pointers. Field this[16] (byte offset 0x40) is written to *a2 and field this[17] (byte offset 0x44) to *a3, each guarded by a null check on the output pointer. Returns a3 (the second output pointer). Pure read/copy getter with no side effects; called from camera and car-selection paths.

local_names.a3: second optional output pointer receiving this[17] (offset 0x44); also the return value
local_names.result: a3 forwarded as the return value

operations.description: a2 is a nullable output pointer; the write to *a2 is skipped when a2 is null.
Copy this[16] (field at byte offset 0x40) into *a2.
a3 is a nullable output pointer; the write to *a3 is skipped when a3 is null.
Copy this[17] (field at byte offset 0x44) into *a3.
Return a3 (the second output pointer) as the result.
